notes.title: Major Update - Version 1.2.0
notes.content:
1.2.0 Is here! This update adds 6 new minigames to the roster, along with updates to current games! UI and UX has also been refined adding player names, highlighting to local players, changes to the next game selection system and an update to the input system which should improve compatibility with controllers. This is on top of various bugfixes and tweaks to make for a more enjoyable and smooth session!

New Minigames:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126736/ee5ae2b1341a56010efd600b7176759ec425e33c.gif
There are 6 new minigames to end your friendships on. Including a rage inducing pogo-stick race, a musket shootout and a dig for treasure!/b]

Check out the full patch notes below!

General Changes:

Improved a variety of sound effects
Added connection monitoring to host
Added name tags above player icons
Vehicles now have highlights
Highlight for local players added to various games
Last played game details now in graph
Voting visibility now increased
Added more information for next game in loading screen
Next game selection now weighted towards voting or player choose
Same player can't select next game twice in a row

Minigame Changes:

New game "Bean Ball"
New game "Plinko"
New game "Goldiggers"
New game "Platform Runner"
New game "Single Shot"
New game "Pogo Race"
Added motorbikes to "Cross Chaos"
Increased weapon hit-area on "Swingers"
Point add speed now decreases relative to player count on "Zoneholder"
Added obstacles to final platforms on "Pathfinder"
Improved markers on "Pisted-Off"
Improved controls on "Scooter Slalom"
Redesigned map on "Chargershot"
Added player color beams on "Chargershot"
Fixed prediction issues in "Uphill Mayhem"
Fixed prediction issues in "Chaotic Cross"
Modified controls in Chainers

Bugfixes:

Fixed collision VFX/SFX issues on clients
Improved controller support and compatibility issues
Fixed issues with glitches on dead players
Fixed various errors that occurred with higher latency


If you have any new minigame ideas or are finding issues please join the Discord!

notes.title: Major Update - Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
1.1.0 Is here! This is a sizable update that adds 7 new minigames, tweaks some others and adds some new elements to the game sessions. This is on top of a UI overhaul to support multiple languages and 16X10 & 21:9 aspect ratios! The three biggest changes are:  

New Minigames:
There are 7 new minigames to end your friendships on. From skiing to fighting with chainsaws.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126736/581dc8f31a87872286a373a0c368bf3cf7086644.gif
Game Modifiers:
3 Modifiers can be randomly applied to any minigame. These double winnings or punish the losers.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126736/035b27d7e1d521e2da9bf1ed2dad92680bbcd7ec.gif
Next Game Selection:
The next game is now selected at the end of the previous one. Sometimes it’s random, other times players can cast their vote.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45126736/e3d9955d3215fef7fbf3d56eb8fad5ff5e2a582c.gif

Check out the full patch notes below!

General Changes:

Added various next game selection mechanics
Added randomised next game modifiers
Added next game and modifier info to loading screen
Adjust betting algorithm to focus on recent results
Revamped the lobby and setup screen
Revamped UI with new colour scheme and fonts that support multiple languages
Added ability to change color of the bean
Added various languages and automatic language detection
Changed ready-up button on controllers
Revamped bloom and added additional settings for it
Added support for 16:10 & 21:9 monitors
Updated privacy policy
 Removed "First To" game type.

Bugfix Changes:

 Updated various graphic assets to deal with various issues
 Fixed some issues related to reconnecting
 Fixed various physics issues with the avatar
 Hopefully fixed issue with crashing on game launch

Minigame Changes:

 Added new game "Angry Beans"
 Added new game "Pisted Off"
 Added new game "Chainers"
 Added new game "Swingers"
 Added new game "Chicken"
 Added new game "Charge Shot"
 Added new game "Platform Roulette"
 Changed "Speary Me" to first to 10 kills
 Added melee weapon to Smack Out
 Added language support for Quick Cards
 Modified jump on Scooter Slalom


Hope you had Merry Christmas/Happy holiday and enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Patch Version 1.0.14 (Hotfix / Crashes)
notes.content:
I have been getting reports of players not being able to get into the game, some not making it into the menu. The bug reports were vague but some mentioned the full-screen mode being borderless can be a cause, so I have now change how full-screen handles by default. Can you also please can you make sure your graphics drivers are up-to-date as this could also cause crashes. 

If you issues please join the Discord and get in-touch with me directly and I'll do my best to get to the bottom of any of the issues!

Included changes from the last patch notes since it's so recent

Bug Fixes:
* Changed full-screen mode to no longer borderless by default as might be linked with crash
* Added cloud diagnostics to help tracked down issues easier
* Implemented Steam authentication (Think some peeps have stolen the game)
* Removed the annoying debug object when you press C

General Changes:
* Added privacy policy for crash and error collection

Minigame Changes:
* Stop N Start: Hopefully fixed lightmap issues once and for all
* Fight Bikes: Respawn i-frames increased
* Fight Bikes: Pipe hitbox increased
* Speary Me: Fixed spear issues on client
* Kart Hockey: Added mechanic to flip upright if turned over
